title: director.ai/1
description: data/director/ai.json: the AI's skill numbers (sim/director/ai.gd). Under ADR 0008 the AI plays by the player's rules and gets an outcome only by an input; these numbers say how often it makes that input. One difficulty for now. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Every chance is from 0 to 1. `level` names one of `levels` (xref ai-level); the levels do not get easier from easy to hard (a warning, ai-levels-order); the old top-level beamAnswer is the medium level's (a warning, ai-level-beam).

pressReact.description: Per defender stance: the chance the AI has an attack request in when it is attacked in that stance (the press: a trade or a counter needs the defender's own request).

beamAnswer.description: The chance the AI answers a beam when it can: with its own signature, or else a heavy blast.

sigPick.description: The chance an AI attack is the signature, with the ki and the cooldown over.

guard.description: The chance the AI perfect-blocks a strike with a window while it holds Guard.

press.description: The same while it holds Press.

heavyAdd.description: Added against a heavy or an ender.

perfectBlock.description: stance-matrix.md R5: the chance the AI perfect-blocks a strike with a window, by the state it holds (none while dodging or escaping). Each level multiplies it by perfectBlockMul.

level.description: The level a match runs at unless the host sets another.

beamAnswer.description: The chance the AI answers a beam when it can (control-rules.md section 10).

perfectBlockMul.description: Its share of the perfectBlock rates above.

guardRepeat.description: Weight added to its Guard choice while the rival repeats one attack.

punish.description: The chance it attacks in the punish window after it blocked a whole string.

punishHeavy.description: The share of those attacks that are heavies.

reversal.description: [the chance after 2 s of guard with over 25 ki, otherwise].

breakGuard.description: The share of its attacks that are heavies against a rival it has found guarding twice running.

riposte.description: The chance it takes its riposte after a perfect block.

burstAtLink.description: The chain link at which it bursts out (0: never).

launchIntent.description: The chance the AI presses a heavy with the stick held when a launch would be earned (the earned launch).

heldHeavy.description: The chance the AI holds a heavy for the held-heavy launch.

farTaunt.description: The chance it taunts from far off.

farCharge.description: The chance it holds a charge from far off.

farHeavy.description: The chance a far press is a heavy.

answerTaunt.description: The chance it answers a taunt.

approachReact.description: Three chances for how it reacts to an approach; they sum to at most 1 (the rest: nothing).

earnerUse.description: How often the AI uses an earner at all (agency-pass.md section 13, rule 7): it multiplies launchIntent, heldHeavy and the far heavy that stays a heavy charge.

blastShare.description: The share of the AI's presses outside an exchange that are blasts.

buriedFollowUp.description: The chance the AI takes the free follow-up on a buried rival.

buriedBurst.description: The chance the AI bursts out when it is buried.

barrageGuard.description: The chance the AI guards against a barrage of bolts.

beamDodge.description: The chance its dodge is in time when it is dodging a beam.

beamWade.description: The chance it holds toward when it guards a beam (the wade).

beamLate.description: The chance of a late answer when it did not answer in the tell and can pay for one.

mineShare.description: The chance an AI blast press is a mine.

timedPress.description: The chance an AI press is timed (on the beat).

tapGap.description: The gap between the AI's taps, in ticks.

string.description: The length of the AI's string, in blows: [lo, hi].

guardTicks.description: How long it guards, in ticks: [lo, hi].

perfectMul.description: The multiplier on its perfect-block chance in a brawl.

nudgeShare.description: The chance the AI nudges with the stick in a brawl.

walkOut.description: The chance the AI walks out of a brawl.

mediumVsHeavies.description: Against a rival whose last two blows were heavies, the share of its strings that are mediums.

perfectVsHeavy.description: Its perfect block against a heavy it sees wound in a brawl.

tapGapMax.description: The slowest gap, in ticks, between the AI taps in a brawl (at least tapGap: rule brawl-order). Added 2026-10-11 on the EP request.

chargeGuess.description: The share of a rival's charged heavies the AI tries to perfect-block, by guessing the release (it never reacts to it).

catch.description: The share of a rival's guards (each 30 ticks of one) and seen heavy wind-ups it catches.

pummel.description: The share of pulses it pummels on.

tech.description: The share of catches it techs.

anywhere.description: The AI's launcher with launch anywhere on.

launcher.description: The share of openings at which it launches.

inString.description: The share of hard-to-answer moments in its string at which it launches.

answer.description: The share of launchers that are not sure it answers, by a guess made at a landed blow of his before it (it never reacts to one).

flip.description: The share of its knock-backs it flips out of.

counter.description: The share of its flips it follows with a counter-rush.

perfectVsMash.description: Game Design 10-26 item 21: its perfect-block chance in a brawl against a mash (interrupts.json brawl.launcher.anywhere.answer.mashTicks), at least; read only with answer.enabled.

brawl.description: The AI's brawl play at this level.

guardShare.description: The chance it guards against a shooter in a brawl.

enderShare.description: The chance it throws the ender (which would knock him away) against a shooter.

heavyApproachShare.description: The chance it comes in with the heavy lunge or charge, the approach a bolt does not stop.

vsShooter.description: The AI against a shooter (a rival who has fired in the last 90 ticks and landed no melee blow in the last 120).

zipShare.description: The chance the AI zips in from the band.

zipHeavyShare.description: The chance a zip it makes is the heavy.

zipCounter.description: The chance it counters with a zip.

zipDodge.description: The chance it turns a dodge into a zip.

zipExit.description: The share of its zips that pick an exit other than back.

zipPunish.description: The share at which it presses a light on a zipper in reach once his blow has resolved.

forms.description: The AI's holds of a ready step (hero-forms.md section 4b), with forms on.

holdS.description: It holds a ready step this many seconds at most (0: never).

whenAbove.description: ... while its rival's tier is above its own.

coilUnder.description: ... while its coil is under this.

untilBattered.description: ... and none of its own regions battered.

wallKick.description: The share of its sends into a wall that holds it kicks off.

chaseShare.description: The share of its sends it chases (Game Design's 5d: 10, 25, 40%).

rally.description: The AI in a rally (rulings-2026-10-23d): its share of chasing a body it sent in a rally of its own (in place of chaseShare), its tech shares at a link's arrival (a kind new to the rally, one used before, the same as the last), its daze mash (a shave every daze.shaveEvery) and burst out, its burst out of a link in flight. Its choice of link is the choreographer's scoring (data/director/rally.json).
